actor_update.on_reject: Restore both models, both Adam states, sampler RNG and counters. Use the same already collected batch for a lower-rate proposal. Stop if none passes.

offline_sequence.source: The closed protocol's saved 32-world probe and its original weighted parent checkpoint
offline_sequence.scope: Saved CPU fixtures use the original recorded actions and rewards. Test sequential numerical headroom and reject handling. No policy artifact is saved.

gate_for_a_new_physical_trial: Both arms complete the offline sequence within the original replay limits, with sufficient remaining headroom and bounded reduced-rate updates.
The two arms start from the same original weighted parent. Share the step-control rule, retention replay, initial optimizers and physical conditions. Record accepted scales independently.
Freeze a separate named protocol with a matched physical budget, independent evaluator, no changed motion thresholds, and actual matched GPU zero-step checks before sampling.
evaluation: Keep the original timely and final holds, per-pose gates, coverage and retention-effect requirements. Compare with the fixed weighted starting model and the matched continuation on a new development seed.
